task.title: Introduce lifecycle trace schema and cold catalog model
task.summary: Add the canonical lifecycle trace and cold catalog model as clean-cut v1 source truth, without legacy compatibility shims.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can read, write, and validate v1 lifecycle trace files and a cold-trace catalog as primary trace artifacts.
acceptance: A v1 JSON lifecycle trace schema/type captures lifecycle, relations, scope, decision, planning, implementation, and accountability sections.
DecisionTableV1 is the canonical structured approval surface under trace.decision.decision_table with table metadata and normalized row fields.
telemetry/catalog.json schema/type records compact cold trace metadata and Git restore refs.
Legacy decision_build, planning_build, implementation_build, and gate report roots are not normalized through compatibility shims in the new telemetry model.
Trace files stay ref-first and do not embed raw Pi transcripts, raw diffs, whole KB docs, or full source snapshots.
Lexicon/source-contract tests either pass or report only explicitly deferred legacy wording with deletion triggers.
non_goals: Do not migrate all existing historical artifacts in one sweep.
Do not add SQLite cache yet.
Do not add compatibility shims for legacy build/gate roots.

delta.desired: Lifecycle trace and catalog schemas exist as clean-cut primary trace artifacts without compatibility shims.
delta.current: Telemetry target exists only in docs; legacy build/gate roots remain separate and are not shimmed into the new trace model.
delta.closure: Task closes when tests prove trace/catalog schema and ref-first validation can support primary trace consumers without compatibility normalization.
